sentences.text:
PRADUMN SINGH Petitioner(s)
 VERSUS  THE STATE OF RAJASTHAN Respondent(s)

(IA No. 117989/2023 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T.)
 Date : 16-08-2023 These matters were called on for hearing today.

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Abhisar Bhanu, AOR  Mr. Prince, Adv.
 Mr. O.P. Solanki, Adv.
 Mr. Marshall Siddiqui, Adv.
 For Respondent(s) Mr. Ashutosh Shekhar Paarcha, Adv.
 Mr. Milind Kumar, AOR  Mr. S.K. Sinha, AOR  Mr. Shubham Kashyap, Adv.
 Mrs. Seema Kashyap, Adv.
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Pradumn Singh vs The State Of Rajasthan on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73601389/
1

The petitioner who is the husband apprehends the arrest for the offence under Section 498A, 406,
506, 495, 420, 376, 377 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code in FIR No.330 of 2022 registered with Police Station Kathumar District Alwar, Rajasthan.

On perusal of records, we find that even the High Court was pleased to grant anticipatory bail initially but thereafter proceed to reject only on the premise that the petitioner has not cooperated with the investigation.
In pursuance to the interim order granted by this Court dated 30.06.2023, the petitioner has joined the investigation and extended his cooperation.

Taking into consideration of fact that the complaint has been given by the father-in-law of the petitioner and going into the nature of allegation made, we are inclined to grant bail subject to compliance of Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
The Trial Court may impose adequate conditions as it decides.
Accordingly, the prayer for special leave to appeal is allowed and present petition is disposed of.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.

(KAVITA PAHUJA) (RAM SUBHAG SINGH)
COURT MASTER (SH) COURT MASTER (NSH)
